name: dbscan
expr: [idx, core] = dbscan(X, 0.5, 3); idx_pre = dbscan(D, 0.5, 3, 'Distance', 'precomputed'); idx_min = dbscan(X, 0.5, 3, 'Distance', 'minkowski', 'P', 3); idx_cb = dbscan(X, 1.0, 3, 'Distance', 'cityblock');
comment: Sig: [idx, corepts] = dbscan(X, eps, minpts, 'Distance'|'P', val, ...). Coverage: euclidean default, precomputed, minkowski with P, cityblock. Noise = -1 (MATLAB R2025b convention).
